... [*This direct chain flows continuously in the exact same direction through Alexander, Bobby, Kayla, Megan, Gabriel, Emily, Bruce, Jean, Helen, Ryan, Maria, Justin, Noah, Patrick, Eric, and so on...*]
19. Christina is Richard's descendant. (Richard -> Christina)
20. Christina is Marilyn's ancestor. (Christina -> Marilyn)
21. Marilyn is Arthur's ancestor. (Marilyn -> Arthur)
22. Arthur is Martha's ancestor. (Arthur -> Martha)

Every single relationship forms a direct link where the individual progressively follows one another in the exact same direction down the generational timeline mapping from ancestor to descendant. Moving consistently all the way to the end of the chain, we find that Russell is at the very top (the oldest ancestor in this path) and Janet is at the very bottom.

Therefore, Janet is a direct descendant of Russell.
